The following events took place in '''46 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]], an armada of 200 slave-rigged [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]], is completed.<ref name="NEC" />
*The [[Candorian colonies]] are decimated by an outbreak of the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]], leaving the disease with no means of reproducing itself.<ref name="J7" />
*[[Keriin Haslip]] takes control of [[RH Mining Corporation]].<ref name="J5">{{JournalCite|5|Turning Point (Charlene Newcomb)}}</ref>
*[[King/Legends|King]] [[Blackart]] begins his rule over [[Solay]].
*[[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] becomes [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
*[[Palpatine/Legends|Senator Palpatine]] moves into his new [[Palpatine's apartment/Legends|suite]] in [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]], coinciding with the ascension of King Veruna to the throne.<ref name="DPN">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
*[[Karae Nalvas]] falls to the dark side.<ref name="cp">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths}}</ref>
*[[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]] takes up the work of a mercenary pilot.<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">''[[The Starfighter Trap]]'', Till claims she had been a mercenary pilot for 13 years, which, given that the story takes place in 33 BBY, allows to arrive at the date of 46 BBY.</ref>
*[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] hosts a [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]] on [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]].<ref name="DPN">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

==Births==
[[File:PadmeCelebration.jpg|thumb|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Naberrie]], the future [[Queen/Legends|Queen Amidala]], is born on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].]]

*[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Naberrie]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref>{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}} establishes that [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was born 46 years before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to 46 BBY per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>
*[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] on [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]]<ref name="The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>
*[[Yeorg Captison]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] {{Circa}}
